name: ema61_breakout/monthly_candle_stop_nifty200_rtargets
description: Monthly candle opens below and closes above EMA61; buy above its high next month; stop at its low. No new entries while NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average (Sensex before mid-2008). Targets set as multiples of the initial risk (1R-3R); P1.5R = half at 1.5R, rest by the trend exit.
